scripts.build: npm run build -w @credipass/api && npm run build -w @credipass/shared-types && npm run build -w @credipass/config
scripts.test: npm run test -w @credipass/api && npm run test:e2e -w @credipass/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @credipass/api && npm run lint -w @credipass/shared-types && npm run lint -w @credipass/config
scripts.contract:generate: npm run contract:openapi && npm run contract:types
scripts.ci: npm run contract:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
